kurz: Roast vegetables turn sweet and browned rather than steamed when they go into the oven dry, spaced out and hot.
bild_im_kopf: Hanging out washing rather than drying it in a heap.

schluesselmomente.schritt: Cut into pieces of equal size
schluesselmomente.warum: Everything is done at the same time.

schluesselmomente.schritt: Dry and toss thinly in oil
schluesselmomente.warum: Oil carries heat into every corner; water would slow things down.

schluesselmomente.schritt: Spread out on the preheated tray
schluesselmomente.warum: Steam can escape and the underside browns at once.
[[maillard-reaktion|Maillard]] and [[karamellisierung|caramelisation]] make the vegetables sweet and aromatic.
